record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.original_question: Suppose a Banach space X contains an infinite-dimensional subspace Y such that Y admits an equivalent norm with numerical index 1. Determine whether X must also admit an equivalent norm with numerical index 1.

evidence.quote: Problem 20. Let X be a Banach space containing an infinite-dimensional subspace Y such that 1 ∈ N (Y ). Is it true that 1 ∈ N (X)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a (real or complex) Banach space. For a bounded linear operator T: X → X, define its numerical radius by
  v(T) = sup{ |x*(Tx)| : x ∈ X, x* ∈ X*, ‖x‖ = ‖x*‖ = x*(x) = 1 },
and define the numerical index of X by
  n(X) = inf{ v(T) : T ∈ L(X), ‖T‖ = 1 }.
One says that X has numerical index 1 when n(X) = 1, i.e. v(T) = ‖T‖ for every bounded linear operator T on X. Two norms on X are equivalent if they induce the same topology.

Question: Suppose that X is a Banach space which contains an infinite-dimensional closed subspace Y such that Y admits an equivalent norm under which the numerical index of Y equals 1. Must X itself admit an equivalent norm under which the numerical index of X equals 1?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether a Banach space X must admit an equivalent norm with numerical index 1 whenever it contains an infinite-dimensional subspace with this property is listed as an open problem in surveys on the numerical index of Banach spaces. Subsequent works on the numerical index (including Martín's notes and later papers on Lipschitz numerical index and isomorphic renormings) continue to cite related inheritance questions without recording a resolution. No evidence of a solution was found.

status_evidence.title: Numerical range of operators, numerical index of Banach spaces (Martín, notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of the set N(X) of values of the numerical index obtainable by equivalent renormings; lists open problems on renormings with numerical index 1.
status_evidence.claim: Renorming questions for numerical index 1 are treated as open problems in subsequent expositions.

status_evidence.title: Historical Introduction: A Walk on the Results for Banach Spaces with Numerical Index 1
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of results and open problems on Banach spaces with numerical index 1.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys post-2006 still discuss open inheritance/renorming problems for numerical index 1.
